Cheerful hello care team,
Mid-afternoon changed little, but rest breaks stayed in focus

Keep checking carrier labels, water notes, and handoff remarks so the next teammate can pick up smoothly. If a traveler seems unsure, use plain wording and steer them toward the safest option first. <<FACT F003>> Stay calm, document anything unusual, and avoid rushing a pet through a step that deserves a second look. Use the same careful tone with every traveler, because steady guidance keeps the whole desk reliable.

Please also remember to confirm crate fit, leash handling, and comfort checks before transfer. <<FACT F012>> <<FACT F047>> When you finish a case, leave a brief note that helps the next shift understand what was done and what still needs attention. Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk patient, consistent, and kind.
